expo.name: RakshaNet
expo.description: RakshaNet - disaster-risk intelligence and strategic relocation platform. Citizen and Volunteer mobile app (SIH 2026, PS 26191, Team Jeevan Setu).

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RakshaNet uses your location to attach accurate GPS coordinates to SOS alerts, hazard reports and vulnerability reports.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RakshaNet uses your camera to attach photo evidence to hazard and vulnerability reports.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RakshaNet lets you attach photos from your gallery as evidence on hazard and vulnerability reports.
